_comment: TEST-ONLY golden vector pinning the kiosk<->server Ed25519 request-signing contract. Read by client/test_signing_vector.py and checkin-app/src/lib/__tests__/verifyKioskSignature.test.ts; if either side changes the message template, a header name, or the encoding, its own test goes red. Ed25519 is deterministic (RFC 8032), so a fixed (seed, message) always yields this exact signature.
_security: test_only_private_key_seed_hex is a throwaway keypair generated for this fixture and is PUBLIC. NEVER write it to a kiosk's client.key, and NEVER set test_only_public_key_hex as KIOSK_PUBLIC_KEY on any instance — doing so lets anyone forge signed kiosk requests.
